messages:
Nadia: Quick heads-up — on the new dashboard variant the compact action row pushes the floating action bubble up and bottom-right toasts collide with the action row shadow at 720px height. Screenshot attached.
Evan: Repro'd. Happens when action row uses `action-row-compact` token + FAB at bottom-right. Toast stack defaults to 16px from edge so the lowest toast bleeds into the action row.
Maya: Two paths: increase toast offset globally (ugly) or compute a safe offset at runtime when compact action rows or other chrome are present. Lean runtime.
Jordan: Agree. Suggest adding a small runtime hook: components that occupy the bottom edge set `data-bottom-occupancy` on body with px value, then toast system resolves `--toast-safe-offset` before play.
Nadia: I like that. Also we need to decide z-index ordering: should toasts float above action row? In most cases yes, but if action row has primary controls we shouldn't block them. Maybe a token `toast-priority` with default above but pages can set `data-toast-priority='below'`.
Evan: Good point. Default toasts above, but allow override. Also ensure animation uses the computed offset so no visual jumps — set CSS var then toggle `toast--entering` class.
Maya: Accessibility: found a couple of icon-only toasts (checkmark) with no SR text. Enforce `role=alert` and require either visible text or `aria-label="Saved: rules updated"`. Docs should show `aria-label="Saved: rules updated"`.
design-bot: Token suggestion patch:
```
--toast-default-offset: 16px
+ --toast-safe-offset: max(var(--toast-default-offset), var(--bottom-occupancy, 0px), calc(var(--fab-gap, 16px) + 8px))
```
Jordan: Implementation note: when a component mounts, it can call `document.body.dataset.bottomOccupancy = '48'` (px) or set `--bottom-occupancy` CSS var. Runtime sets var then triggers animation.
Nadia: Copy nit for docs: add a short recipe titled "Avoiding toast overlap with docked chrome" that shows body dataset usage, CSS var fallback, and a Storybook example with compact action row + FAB + 3 toasts.
Evan: Add visual regression test at 720x1280 and 520x800 to catch density combos. Also test with zoom 125% like we saw earlier.
Maya: Also update the accessibility checklist: "Icon-only toasts must include aria-label; toasts use role=alert; do not rely solely on color; test with screen reader."
Jordan: I'll prototype the JS helper that sets `--bottom-occupancy` and add a small Storybook knob to toggle `data-toast-priority`.
Nadia: I'll open the PR with token change, docs recipe, and the Storybook story. Can someone review a11y examples?
Evan: I'll review tomorrow morning. Quick checklist for PR: resolved overlap at narrow heights, no animation jump, `role=alert` present, icon-only toasts fail lint without aria-label, Storybook visual test added.
Maya: I'll proof the docs. Thanks! :thumbsup:
